name: Potentially Visible Hidden Volume (PVHV)
definition: PVHVs are 3D volumes that are occluded at a known source view but potentially visible at novel views. They are used to batch-test visibilities of source fragments without iterating individual novel views, allowing culling of redundant fragments prior to warping.
summary: Potentially Visible Hidden Volumes are 3D regions occluded at a source view but visible at novel views, defined by edge-based geometric analysis to efficiently cull redundant fragments in multi-view warping.
